# Feature Request

## Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation this feature would solve.

---

## Proposed Solution

Explain how you would like this feature to work.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you have considered.

---

## Benefits

Explain how this feature would improve CreditSense AI and benefit users.

---

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, mockups, references, or examples if applicable.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues before creating this request.
- [ ] This is a feature request and not a bug report.
- [ ] I have clearly described the proposed feature.
- [ ] I have included relevant examples or references.
